name: Lena Schmidt
bio: Lena grew up around the Nürburgring, her family owning a small motorsport memorabilia shop. While she never formally pursued a career in racing herself, her passion for the sport runs deep. She's a self-proclaimed social butterfly, always eager to meet new people and network within the racing community. Beneath her friendly exterior lies a strong-willed personality; she knows what she wants and isn't afraid to go after it. Lena is searching for a partner who shares her enthusiasm for racing, appreciates her independent spirit, and is ready to build a future together, complete with a comfortable lifestyle and a loving family. She values loyalty and ambition above all else.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair styled in loose braids, often with strands framing her face
physical.description: Lena has a petite build and a bright, engaging smile. Her eyes are her most striking feature, often sparkling with enthusiasm.

meetingContext: At a Formula 3 race after-party, hosted by a mutual friend who works as a mechanic for one of the teams.
firstImpression: She's laughing easily with a group of people, her eyes crinkling at the corners, and you immediately notice her confident posture and genuine warmth.
interests: Traveling to different race tracks around the world
Photography (especially capturing action shots at races)
Social media management (unofficially helps a small racing team)
dealBreakers: Disrespect for her family and friends
loveLanguage: Words of Affirmation. She appreciates being told how much she's valued and loved, and thrives on genuine compliments and encouragement.
